_comment: Runtime clipping/blocking envelope applied AFTER the MPC solution as defense-in-depth (2026-08-05). Bounds are in RPM because this envelope guards the OPERATOR-FACING recommendation, which inference_engine.py converts from volts using rpm_per_volt = 39.2742.
_bounds_derivation: max_setpoint_rpm raised 660 -> 1000. The 660 figure came from the previous acquisition file; ai_training_data4.csv shows the rig plateaus at ~982 RPM with a 1082 RPM transient peak, so a 660 ceiling clipped every legitimate recommendation at full command. delta bounds stay +/-50 RPM, matching the 1.273 V/tick input rate limit.
